blocks.text: a friend of mine, my own, on my own

Bu darsda egalik bilan bog'liq uchta qolip bor va ularning har biri o'zbekchada tayyor muqobilga ega: «**bir do'stim**» — **a friend of mine**, «**o'z uyim**» — **my own house**, «**yolg'iz o'zim**» — **on my own** / **by myself**. Mustaqil egalik olmoshlari (mine, yours, hers ...) qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 61-dars), by myself esa o'zlik olmoshlari bilan birga (→ qizil kitob, 63-dars; → 82-dars). Endi ularni birlashtiramiz va o'zbeklar ko'p yo'l qo'yadigan xatolarni ko'rib chiqamiz: «a my friend», «an own car», «by my own».

Inglizchada artikl va egalik olmoshi yonma-yon kelmaydi: «a my friend» deyish mumkin emas. «Do'stlarimdan biri» ma'nosi uchun **a friend of mine** ishlatiladi: a + ot + **of** + mustaqil egalik olmoshi (**mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs**). Xuddi shunday: a cousin **of hers**, a colleague **of ours**, some friends **of theirs**, two books **of mine**. Ism yoki ot bilan — **'s**: a friend **of Tom's**, a neighbour **of my parents'**. «a friend of me» — xato. Farqi: **my friend** — tinglovchi biladigan, aniq do'st; **a friend of mine** — do'stlarimdan biri, tinglovchi uni hali bilmaydi.

items.text: **A friend of mine** works at the British Embassy in Tashkent.
Is Sarah **a colleague of yours**? — No, she's my wife's cousin.
We spent the weekend with **some friends of ours** in Oxford.
items.translation: Dam olish kunlarini Oksforddagi **do'stlarimiz** bilan o'tkazdik.

blocks.text: **this / that + ot + of yours** — ko'pincha his-tuyg'u bilan aytiladi: achchiqlanish, maqtov yoki hayrat. **That brother of yours** is always late! — O'sha ukangiz doim kechikadi! **This idea of yours** is brilliant. O'zbekchadagi «o'sha sizning ...», «mana bu ...» ohangiga o'xshaydi.

**own** egalik so'zidan keyin keladi va narsa boshqa hech kimniki emasligini, birov bilan bo'lishilmasligini ta'kidlaydi: my **own** room (o'z xonam — ukam bilan bo'lishmayman), her **own** business, their **own** language, Bekzod**'s own** car. **own** a / an bilan ishlatilmaydi: «an own flat» — xato. Ikki to'g'ri variant bor: **my own flat** yoki **a flat of my own**. O'zbekchada «o'z» so'zi aynan shu vazifani bajaradi: «o'z uyim», «o'z biznesi», «o'z tili».

rows: **my own** room / a room **of my own**
**his own** car / a car **of his own**
**their own** house / a house **of their own**

items.text: I'd love to have **my own** room, but I share one with my two brothers.
items.translation: **O'z xonam** bo'lishini juda istardim, lekin ikki ukam bilan bitta xonada yashayman.

items.text: Dilnoza wants to start **a business of her own** after university.
Every region of Uzbekistan has **its own** kind of plov.
items.translation: O'zbekistonning har bir viloyatida palovning **o'ziga xos** turi bor.

blocks.text: **own** fe'l bilan: make **your own** clothes (kiyimingizni o'zingiz tikasiz), cook **your own** meals, grow **their own** vegetables, do **your own** washing — tayyorini sotib olmasdan yoki boshqalarga qildirmasdan, o'zi qiladi. Fe'l **own** (egalik qilmoq) bilan adashtirmang: Who **owns** this car? — Bu mashina kimniki?
on my own / by myself — «yolg'iz» va «yordamsiz»

**on my own** va **by myself** bir xil ma'noli va ikki holatda ishlatiladi: 1) **yolg'iz**, hech kim bilan birga emas: I live **on my own** / **by myself**; 2) **hech kimning yordamisiz**: She built the website **on her own** / **by herself**. Birinchisida — **own**, ikkinchisida — **-self**; aralashtirib bo'lmaydi: «on myself», «by my own» — xato. **alone** ham «yolg'iz» ma'nosida ishlatiladi, lekin «yordamsiz» ma'nosida emas. O'zbekchada kontekstga qarab «yolg'iz», «o'zim», «o'z-o'zidan» deyiladi.

items.text: Since her husband died, Grandma has lived **on her own** in Bukhara.
items.translation: Eri vafot etganidan beri buvim Buxoroda **yolg'iz** yashaydi.

items.text: Did you really put this wardrobe together **by yourself**?
I don't like going to the cinema **on my own**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «a my friend», «one my friend» → **a friend of mine**; «a friend of me» → **a friend of mine**; «a friend of Tom» → **a friend of Tom's** (yoki **one of Tom's friends**); «an own house» → **my own house** / **a house of my own**; «I want own car» → **I want my own car**; «on myself», «by my own» → **on my own** / **by myself**; «I did it by myself alone» → **I did it by myself** (yoki **on my own**).

Uch juftlikni yodlang: **bir do'stim** — a friend **of mine**; **o'z uyim** — **my own** house = a house **of my own**; **yolg'iz o'zim** — **on my own** = **by myself**. Qoida: **own** oldida doim egalik so'zi (my, your, Tom's) turadi, hech qachon a / an emas.

rows: **a friend of mine**, a cousin **of hers**
my own + ot / a + ot + of my own
**my own** room, a room **of my own**
I live **on my own**. She did it **by herself**.

examples.title: **a friend of mine**, **a colleague of hers**
examples.description: a + ot + of + mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs — «bir do'stim», «uning bir hamkasbi». «a my friend» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: **A friend of mine** has just opened a café near the Registan.
sentences.translation: **Bir do'stim** hozirgina Registon yaqinida kafe ochdi.

sentences.text: Is Jasur **a relative of yours**? You look very similar.
sentences.translation: Jasur **qarindoshingizmi**? Juda o'xshaysizlar.

sentences.text: Emma went on holiday with **a colleague of hers** from the bank.
sentences.translation: Emma bankdagi **bir hamkasbi** bilan ta'tilga ketdi.

sentences.text: **A neighbour of ours** looks after our cat when we're away.
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda mushugimizga **bir qo'shnimiz** qarab turadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod and Madina invited **some friends of theirs** from Fergana to the wedding.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va Madina to'yga Farg'onadagi **ba'zi do'stlarini** taklif qilishdi.

sentences.text: I heard about the job from **a former student of mine** who works there now.
sentences.translation: Bu ish haqida hozir o'sha yerda ishlaydigan **sobiq talabamdan** eshitdim.

sentences.text: Oliver isn't really my friend — he's just **an old classmate of mine**.
sentences.translation: Oliver aslida do'stim emas — shunchaki **eski sinfdoshim**.

sentences.text: That song is **a favourite of mine** — I've listened to it hundreds of times.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq — **sevimli qo'shiqlarimdan biri**, uni yuzlab marta tinglaganman.

sentences.text: Why don't you ask Aziz? **A cousin of his** is a lawyer.
sentences.translation: Nega Azizdan so'ramaysiz? **Uning bir amakivachchasi** huquqshunos.

sentences.text: We stayed with **two old friends of ours** who moved to Edinburgh ten years ago.
sentences.translation: O'n yil oldin Edinburgga ko'chib ketgan **ikki qadrdon do'stimiznikida** turdik.

examples.title: **a friend of Tom's** and **that brother of yours**
examples.description: Ism yoki ot bilan — 's: a friend of Tom's, a colleague of my father's. this / that ... of yours — ko'pincha his-tuyg'u (achchiqlanish, maqtov) bilan.

sentences.text: Kate is **a friend of Tom's**, so she came to his birthday party.
sentences.translation: Keyt **Tomning bir do'sti**, shuning uchun uning tug'ilgan kuniga keldi.

sentences.text: The man in the blue suit is **a colleague of my father's**.
sentences.translation: Ko'k kostyumdagi kishi — **dadamning bir hamkasbi**.

sentences.text: I found the flat through **a cousin of Dilnoza's** who works as an estate agent.
sentences.translation: Kvartirani rieltor bo'lib ishlaydigan **Dilnozaning bir amakivachchasi** orqali topdim.

sentences.text: **That brother of yours** borrowed my car again without asking!
sentences.translation: **O'sha ukang** yana so'ramasdan mashinamni olib ketibdi!

sentences.text: **This new phone of mine** keeps switching itself off — I'm taking it back.
sentences.translation: **Mana bu yangi telefonim** o'zidan-o'zi o'chib qolaveradi — uni qaytarib beraman.

sentences.text: **That idea of yours** about selling plov online is actually brilliant.
sentences.translation: Palovni onlayn sotish haqidagi **o'sha g'oyangiz** aslida juda ajoyib.

sentences.text: Is Mr Hughes **an old friend of your parents'**? He seems to know everyone.
sentences.translation: Janob Xyuz **ota-onangizning eski do'stimi**? U hammani taniydiganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: How's **that cough of yours**? — Much better, thanks.
sentences.translation: **O'sha yo'talingiz** qalay? — Ancha yaxshi, rahmat.

sentences.text: Last night I bumped into **a teacher of Madina's** at the supermarket.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun supermarketda **Madinaning bir o'qituvchisini** uchratib qoldim.

sentences.text: We can't stand **those noisy dogs of theirs** — they bark all night long.
sentences.translation: **Ularning o'sha shovqinli itlariga** chiday olmaymiz — tun bo'yi vovullashadi.

examples.title: **my own room**, **his own business**
examples.description: own egalik so'zidan keyin: my own, her own, Madina's own — narsa boshqa hech kimniki emas, bo'lishilmaydi. O'zbekchadagi «o'z ...».

sentences.text: When I was a child, I didn't have **my own** room — I shared with my sister.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda **o'z xonam** yo'q edi — opam bilan bitta xonada yashardim.

sentences.text: After ten years at the bank, Aziz decided to start **his own** business.
sentences.translation: Bankda o'n yil ishlagach, Aziz **o'z biznesini** boshlashga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: Each student will get **their own** laptop for the course.
sentences.translation: Kurs davomida har bir talaba **o'zining shaxsiy** noutbukiga ega bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Is that **your own** car, or is it the company's?
sentences.translation: Bu **o'zingizning** mashinangizmi yoki kompaniyaniki?

sentences.text: Karakalpakstan has **its own** language, which is close to Kazakh.
sentences.translation: Qoraqalpog'istonning **o'z tili** bor, u qozoq tiliga yaqin.

sentences.text: Madina's **own** children are grown up, so she looks after her grandchildren.
sentences.translation: Madinaning **o'z** farzandlari katta bo'lib qolgan, shuning uchun u nevaralariga qaraydi.

sentences.text: Why do you need **your own** flat? You can stay with us for as long as you like.
sentences.translation: Senga **o'z kvartirang** nimaga kerak? Biznikida xohlaganingcha turaverishing mumkin.

sentences.text: The company has **its own** training centre, so new staff don't have to go anywhere.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyaning **o'z** o'quv markazi bor, shuning uchun yangi xodimlar hech qayerga borishi shart emas.

sentences.text: I'd rather sleep in **my own** bed than in the most expensive hotel.
sentences.translation: Eng qimmat mehmonxonadan ko'ra **o'z to'shagimda** uxlaganim afzal.

sentences.text: Everyone has **their own** opinion about the new law, and that's fine.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun haqida har kimning **o'z fikri** bor, bu normal holat.

examples.title: **a room of my own** — never «an own room»
examples.description: own a / an bilan ishlatilmaydi: «an own flat» emas — my own flat yoki **a flat of my own**.

sentences.text: Jasur is saving up to buy **a flat of his own** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Jasur Toshkentda **o'z kvartirasini** sotib olish uchun pul yig'yapti.

sentences.text: One day I'd like to have **a garden of my own** with apricot trees.
sentences.translation: Bir kun kelib o'rik daraxtlari o'sadigan **o'z bog'im** bo'lishini istardim.

sentences.text: Bekzod's sister doesn't have **a car of her own**, so she borrows his.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning opasining **o'z mashinasi** yo'q, shuning uchun uning mashinasini olib turadi.

sentences.text: Every child needs **a space of their own** where they can study quietly.
sentences.translation: Har bir bolaga tinch o'qiy oladigan **o'z burchagi** kerak.

sentences.text: Emma has finally got **a room of her own** after years of sharing with her sister.
sentences.translation: Emma yillar davomida opasi bilan bitta xonada yashagach, nihoyat **o'z xonasiga** ega bo'ldi.

sentences.text: They've got three kids **of their own** and two foster children.
sentences.translation: Ularning uchta **o'z** farzandi va ikkita asrab olingan bolasi bor.

sentences.text: Is it better to rent or to buy **a house of your own**?
sentences.translation: Ijaraga olgan yaxshimi yoki **o'z uyingizni** sotib olganmi?

sentences.text: Nilufar dreams of opening **a clinic of her own** in her home town.
sentences.translation: Nilufar tug'ilgan shahrida **shaxsiy klinikasini** ochishni orzu qiladi.

sentences.text: Without **a computer of my own**, I had to do my homework in the library.
sentences.translation: **O'z kompyuterim** bo'lmagani uchun uy vazifamni kutubxonada qilishga majbur edim.

sentences.text: The hotel has **a beach of its own**, so you don't have to share it with the public.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaning **o'z plyaji** bor, shuning uchun uni boshqalar bilan bo'lishishingiz shart emas.

examples.title: Do it yourself: **make your own**, **grow their own**
examples.description: own + fe'l: make / cook / grow / bake your own ... — tayyorini olmasdan, o'zi qiladi. Fe'l **own** (egalik qilmoq) bilan adashtirmang.

sentences.text: My grandmother still **bakes her own** bread in a tandoor in the yard.
sentences.translation: Buvim hali ham hovlidagi tandirda **nonini o'zi yopadi**.

sentences.text: In the village most families **grow their own** vegetables and fruit.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda ko'pchilik oilalar sabzavot va mevani **o'zlari yetishtiradi**.

sentences.text: At this café you can **make your own** pizza and choose any toppings you like.
sentences.translation: Bu kafeda **pitsani o'zingiz tayyorlab**, istagan masallig'ingizni tanlashingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Students at the hostel have to **cook their own** meals and do **their own** washing.
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonadagi talabalar **ovqatini o'zlari pishirishi** va **kirini o'zlari yuvishi** kerak.

sentences.text: Kate **designs her own** jewellery and sells it online.
sentences.translation: Keyt **taqinchoqlarini o'zi loyihalaydi** va ularni onlayn sotadi.

sentences.text: Do you **make your own** yoghurt? It tastes much better than the shop one.
sentences.translation: **Qatiqni o'zingiz uyitasizmi**? Do'kondagisidan ancha mazali ekan.

sentences.text: Since the divorce, Oliver has learnt to **iron his own** shirts.
sentences.translation: Ajrashganidan beri Oliver **ko'ylaklarini o'zi dazmollashni** o'rgandi.

sentences.text: Who **owns** the house on the corner? — An old couple from London.
sentences.translation: Burchakdagi uy **kimniki**? — Londonlik keksa er-xotinniki.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **own** two restaurants but still **cook their own** dinner every night.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimizning ikkita restorani **bor**, lekin baribir har kecha kechki ovqatni **o'zlari pishirishadi**.

sentences.text: If you **build your own** website, you'll save money, but it'll take a lot of time.
sentences.translation: Saytingizni **o'zingiz yaratsangiz**, pulni tejaysiz, lekin ko'p vaqt ketadi.

examples.title: Alone: **on my own** / **by myself**
examples.description: on my own = by myself — «yolg'iz», hech kim bilan birga emas. Shakllari: on her own, by herself, on their own, by themselves.

sentences.text: Since moving to London, Aziz has lived **on his own** in a tiny flat.
sentences.translation: Londonga ko'chganidan beri Aziz kichkina kvartirada **yolg'iz** yashaydi.

sentences.text: I don't mind travelling **by myself** — I can go wherever I want.
sentences.translation: **Yolg'iz** sayohat qilishga qarshi emasman — xohlagan joyimga bora olaman.

sentences.text: Why are you sitting here **on your own**? Come and join us!
sentences.translation: Nega bu yerda **yolg'iz** o'tiribsan? Bizga qo'shil!

sentences.text: The children shouldn't walk home **by themselves** after dark.
sentences.translation: Qorong'i tushgandan keyin bolalar uyga **yolg'iz** qaytmasligi kerak.

sentences.text: Madina spent the evening **by herself**, reading and drinking tea.
sentences.translation: Madina kechqurunni kitob o'qib, choy ichib, **yolg'iz o'zi** o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: Is it safe to leave the dog **on its own** for the whole day?
sentences.translation: Itni kun bo'yi **yolg'iz** qoldirish xavfsizmi?

sentences.text: My grandparents prefer to live **on their own**, even though they're in their eighties.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim sakson yoshdan oshgan bo'lsalar ham, **alohida** yashashni afzal ko'rishadi.

sentences.text: Do you two want to go **by yourselves**, or shall I come with you?
sentences.translation: Ikkalangiz **o'zingiz** borasizmi yoki men ham birga boraymi?

sentences.text: Sometimes I like having lunch **on my own** — it's the only quiet moment of the day.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan **yolg'iz** tushlik qilishni yoqtiraman — bu kunning yagona tinch daqiqasi.

sentences.text: After the guests left, we were finally **on our own** and could relax.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar ketgach, nihoyat **yolg'iz qoldik** va dam olishimiz mumkin edi.

examples.title: Without help: **on her own** / **by herself**
examples.description: on my own / by myself — «hech kimning yordamisiz», «o'zi». by itself — «o'z-o'zidan».

sentences.text: Dilnoza wrote the whole computer program **on her own** in three months.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza butun kompyuter dasturini uch oyda **o'zi** yozib chiqdi.

sentences.text: I can't lift this sofa **by myself** — can you give me a hand?
sentences.translation: Bu divanni **yolg'iz** ko'tara olmayman — yordamlashib yuborasanmi?

sentences.text: Did you really put up all these shelves **on your own**?
sentences.translation: Bu javonlarning hammasini rostdan ham **o'zingiz** o'rnatdingizmi?

sentences.text: Our son learnt to ride a bike **by himself**, without anyone teaching him.
sentences.translation: O'g'limiz velosiped haydashni hech kim o'rgatmasdan **o'zi** o'rgandi.

sentences.text: The door seemed to open **by itself**, which scared us all.
sentences.translation: Eshik **o'z-o'zidan** ochilgandek bo'ldi, bu hammamizni qo'rqitib yubordi.

sentences.text: Most first-year students can't solve this problem **on their own**.
sentences.translation: Birinchi kurs talabalarining ko'pchiligi bu masalani **mustaqil** yecha olmaydi.

sentences.text: We built the website **by ourselves**, so it isn't perfect.
sentences.translation: Saytni **o'zimiz** yaratdik, shuning uchun u mukammal emas.

sentences.text: Can your grandfather still manage **on his own**, or does he need a carer?
sentences.translation: Bobongiz hali ham **o'zini o'zi eplay oladimi** yoki unga qarovchi kerakmi?

sentences.text: You'll have to find the answer **by yourself** — I'm not going to tell you!
sentences.translation: Javobni **o'zing** topishing kerak — men aytmayman!

sentences.text: Although Jasur had never cooked before, he made plov for twenty guests **on his own**.
sentences.translation: Jasur ilgari hech qachon ovqat pishirmagan bo'lsa ham, yigirma mehmon uchun palovni **o'zi** damladi.

examples.title: Dialogue: moving out of my parents' house
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st yangi kvartira haqida gaplashadi — a friend of mine, my own, on my own, by yourself va that ... of yours.

sentences.text: — So, Bekzod, I hear you're finally getting **a flat of your own**!
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Bekzod, nihoyat **o'z kvartirangga** ega bo'layotgan ekansan!

sentences.text: — Yes! **A friend of mine** is moving abroad, so he's renting it to me.
sentences.translation: — Ha! **Bir do'stim** chet elga ko'chib ketyapti, shuning uchun kvartirasini menga ijaraga beryapti.

sentences.text: — Will you live **on your own**, or with a flatmate?
sentences.translation: — **Yolg'iz** yashaysanmi yoki sherik bilanmi?

sentences.text: — **On my own**. I want **my own** space after twenty-five years with my family.
sentences.translation: — **Yolg'iz**. Oilam bilan yigirma besh yil yashagandan keyin **o'z makonim** bo'lishini xohlayman.

sentences.text: — I understand. But can you cook **your own** meals?
sentences.translation: — Tushunaman. Lekin **ovqatingni o'zing** pishira olasanmi?

sentences.text: — Not really, but **a colleague of mine** has promised to teach me.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas, lekin **bir hamkasbim** o'rgatishga va'da berdi.

sentences.text: — And are you moving all the furniture **by yourself**?
sentences.translation: — Mebellarning hammasini **o'zing** ko'chirasanmi?

sentences.text: — No, **some friends of my brother's** have got a van, so they'll help.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **akamning ba'zi do'stlarida** furgon bor, ular yordam berishadi.

sentences.text: — Great. And **that old cat of yours** — is she coming with you?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. **O'sha qari mushuging-chi** — u ham sen bilan ketadimi?

sentences.text: — Of course! She'll be the only flatmate I need, and she won't ask for **her own** room!
sentences.translation: — Albatta! U menga kerak bo'lgan yagona sherik bo'ladi, **o'z xonasini** ham so'ramaydi!
